description: Full agent customization via Nostr events

protocol_boundary.assertion: Avatar, voice, memory, persona, and live-update customization mutations are performed through Nostr draft/action/runtime-control events only. REST may read/render state but must not mutate customization.

criteria: draft schema carries avatar generation/upload/provider selection fields
event codec round-trips avatar customization
provider/style validation rejects unsupported references
runtime application uses Nostr 38384 control/config reload
draft schema carries voice provider config and persona settings
event codec round-trips voice customization
provider/model validation rejects unsupported references
voice hot reload/sample flows are runtime-control scoped
embedding config maps to portable and OpenClaw memorySearch contracts
search params preserve top_k, score threshold, reranking, and session-memory behavior
memory configure params serialize into kind 38384 runtime control envelopes
reindex is required to use runtime control rather than REST mutation
traits, style, tone, and constraints normalize into prompt sections
system prompt sections assemble deterministically
persona update params use the soulfactory-persona/v1 38384 contract
persona validation rejects malformed fields before dispatch
customization hot-reloads without reprovisioning
active managed session is not deleted or respawned
partial draft updates merge safely
resolved spec sync clears stale optional customization config
customization mutations are constrained to event kinds 31952, 1950, and 38384
runtime control tests verify Nostr envelope serialization for memory/persona/config reload
PSTF spec marks REST customization mutations as forbidden

integration_tests.name: OpenClaw managed-agent customization hot-reload
integration_tests.evidence: PSTF verification report records pnpm test extensions/nostr/src/soulfactory-execution.test.ts with 8 passing tests.

integration_tests.evidence: Kind 38384 runtime control envelope preserves soulfactory.persona.update params and OpenClaw prompt patch fields.
